sources.title: Azure OpenAI reasoning models
supports: Microsoft lists gpt-6-astra version 2026-09-03 with Responses, structured outputs, reasoning effort and temperature support.
The table gives a shared 1,050,000-token context, at most 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens.
The unsupported-parameters paragraph expressly exempts GPT-6 Astra. Responses uses max_output_tokens.
limits: These documented interfaces and ceilings do not establish account access, deployment availability, price, latency, quality or safety.
The application caps, temperature 0.1 and reasoning effort low are proposed settings that require endpoint and held-out evaluation.

sources.title: How to generate reproducible output with Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry Models (classic)
supports: Microsoft describes best-effort reproducibility and says determinism is not guaranteed, including when seed and backend fingerprint match.
limits: The article concerns a classic-portal Chat Completions feature. It is a reproducibility caveat, not proof of seed support for this proposed Responses configuration.
Low temperature does not establish factual accuracy, safety or identical responses. No live model comparison was performed.

sources.title: RAG and generative AI in Azure AI Search
supports: RAG retrieves external grounding content before generation.
Microsoft describes classic RAG as suitable when generally available features, simplicity, speed and fine control are priorities.
Chunking and vectorization are indexing steps; hybrid queries and optional semantic ranking are query options.
limits: RAG does not guarantee correctness or citation faithfulness.
Agentic retrieval exists; choosing classic RAG here is a design judgment for a small, tightly controlled pilot.

sources.title: Hybrid search overview
supports: Hybrid search runs keyword and vector queries in parallel and combines results using reciprocal rank fusion.
Keyword search can provide precision for product codes and specialist terms while vector search finds conceptual similarity.
limits: No application-specific relevance gain or accuracy percentage is established.
Part validity still needs deterministic lookup against the authoritative catalogue.

sources.title: Security filters for trimming results in Azure AI Search
supports: A security filter pattern stores principal identifiers and filters results using search.in.
The pattern applies when built-in document ACL support is unavailable.
limits: String filtering is an application-enforced pattern, not automatic identity authorization.
Server-side construction, deny-by-default behavior, tenant boundaries and leakage tests remain implementation requirements.

sources.title: Data, privacy, and security for Models sold by Azure in Microsoft Foundry
supports: Azure excludes customer prompts and outputs from foundation-model training without permission or instruction.
Service storage and abuse review can still apply. Deployment type controls processing geography; stored data has separate geographic and encryption rules.
limits: No zero-retention or unconditional single-region guarantee follows. Customer-specific contract and deployment acceptance remain unverified.
Privacy and legal review must precede customer-data use; no compliance or safety certification is established.

supports: OpenAI publishes a current gpt-6-astra model page and identifies Responses and structured-output support.

sources.title: Azure model retirement schedule and lifecycle policy
supports: The schedule marks GPT-4.1 version 2025-04-14 deprecated, with retirement on 2027-04-14. GPT-4o version 2024-11-20 is Legacy with retirement on 2027-04-14.
Listed o1, o3 and o4-mini alternatives are deprecated with retirement on 2026-11-19.
The lifecycle policy restricts deprecated-model access for new subscriptions; existing-subscription eligibility has a separate definition.
limits: No Astra row or retirement date was found in the inspected schedule. That absence does not establish a retirement date, perpetual availability or the status of a customer deployment.
Model lifecycle and regional availability must be checked for the actual subscription before selection or provisioning.
